requirement: Build a REST API for managing tasks with SQLite persistence. Endpoints: GET /health, CRUD /tasks with title validation (422 on empty), 404 on unknown id.
Build a task manager REST API with CRUD /tasks plus GET /tasks?done=true filter. Same validation (422/404) and /health.
Build a task manager REST API with CRUD /tasks plus a notes field on tasks. Same validation (422/404) and /health.
Build a REST API for a book club: members borrow and return books. GET /health, GET /books, POST /loans to borrow an ISBN, POST /loans/{id}/return to return it, 404 on unknown ISBN.
Build a REST API for a recipe collection. GET /health, GET /recipes, POST /recipes with title required (422 on empty), DELETE /recipes/{id} with 404 on unknown id.
